As Stmicroelectronics Nv (STM) Shares Rose, Putnam Investments Has Increased Its Holding; As Disney Walt Co (DIS) Stock Declined, Iberiabank Has Lowered Its Position
May 21, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Iberiabank Corp decreased its stake in Disney Walt Co (DIS) by 22.57% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Iberiabank Corp sold 8,883 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.57% with the market. The institutional investor held 30,472 shares of the television services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.30 million, down from 39,355 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Iberiabank Corp who had been investing in Disney Walt Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $155.37 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.30% or $0.31 during the last trading session, reaching $104.24. About 1.56 million shares traded. The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) has declined 11.59% since May 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.14% the S&P500.
Putnam Investments Llc increased its stake in Stmicroelectronics Nv (STM) by 8.06% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Putnam Investments Llc bought 283,690 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.70% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 3.80M shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $83.09M, up from 3.52 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Putnam Investments Llc who had been investing in Stmicroelectronics Nv for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $21.48B market cap company. The stock increased 1.71% or $0.4 during the last trading session, reaching $23.83. About 683,510 shares traded. STMicroelectronics N.V. (NYSE:STM) has risen 45.26% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.71% the S&P500.
